response.original_title: Rigmor Gustafsson: Love Makes the Changes – Live at Jazzfestival Viersen 2008
response.overview: Television recording of Swedish singer Rigmor Gustafsson and her quartet at the 22nd Jazzfestival Viersen, performed on September 19, 2008 at the Festhalle in Viersen, Germany. Broadcast by WDR as part of west.art Jazzline, the concert presents a vocal-jazz program blending original songs with repertoire associated with On My Way to You and Alone with You, backed by piano, double bass and drums.
